description: Defines interfaces, classes, and structures related to message storage, metadata, and event handling within the Thunder Core Messaging namespace, including message info, metadata, and control interfaces.

classes.name: IEvent
classes.description: Interface for event objects with serialization and data retrieval methods.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class storing message metadata including type, category, and module.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects with enable, destroy, and metadata methods.

classes.name: MessageInfo
classes.description: Class extending Metadata with timestamp information.

classes.name: IStore
classes.description: Interface for message storage with push and default methods, including nested classes for different message types.

classes.name: IStore::Tracing
classes.description: Extended info for tracing messages, including filename, line number, and class name.

classes.name: IStore::WarningReporting
classes.description: Extended info for warning reports, including callsign.

classes.name: IStore::OperationalStream
classes.description: Extended info for operational stream messages.

classes.name: IStore::Assert
classes.description: Extended info for assert messages, including process ID, name, file, line, and callstack.

methods.name: Tracing::ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of Tracing info.

methods.name: WarningReporting::ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of WarningReporting info.

methods.name: Assert::ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of Assert info.
